newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK Q1 PROFIT 24.5 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK Q1 PROFIT 24.5 MLN EEK.

text.p: Estonia's third largest bank, Uhispank, said on Monday that its first quarter profit was 24.5 million kroons versus a 1996 first quarter profit of 14.0 million kroons.
In a statement, the bank also said that its March profit was 8.3 million kroons compared to 8.2 million kroons in February.
The joint profit of soon-to-be merged Uhispank and Pohja-Eesti pank was 9.4 million kroons compared to February's 10 million kroons.
The joint balance sheet of the two banks was 5.3 billion kroons in March compared with 5.0 billion kroons in February.
